description: This file implements pixel shuffle and unshuffle operations optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS), providing helper functions and wrappers to perform these tensor reshaping operations on GPU.

methods.name: pixel_shuffle_helper
methods.description: A helper function that performs pixel shuffle or unshuffle based on the 'upscale' flag, creating a cached MPS graph and executing it to reshape the tensor accordingly.

methods.name: pixel_shuffle_mps
methods.description: Wrapper function that performs pixel shuffle by calling 'pixel_shuffle_helper' with upscale=true.

methods.name: pixel_unshuffle_mps
methods.description: Wrapper function that performs pixel unshuffle by calling 'pixel_shuffle_helper' with upscale=false.
